wish: someone should make a website where you type your vision level and see what you see without glasses
spec:
Shows a sample sign and scene blurred the way each eye sees it without glasses.
Type the sphere number from your prescription for each eye and pick a viewing distance, or load your own photo.
It ignores astigmatism and focusing effort, so it approximates; it is not an eye test.
notes: Photo is read locally via FileReader and never leaves the device.
